translations.designation: City of Fort-de-France – IT project advisory for AS400 CMMS replacement
translations.description: Replace a legacy AS400 CMMS and manage the entire business-side IT project lifecycle securely, from assessment through deployment. For the City of Fort-de-France, OLING provided financial information systems, GBCP and INFINOE project advisory services in the local authority and intermunicipal public body sector. The documented objective was to replace a legacy AS400 CMMS and structure the management of assets, maintenance operations, inventory, costs, interfaces and data. OLING’s scope covers analysis of the existing environment; requirements gathering; requirements framework; technical specifications and procurement documents (CCTP/DCE); competitive tendering; and support with deployment and acceptance testing. Available delivery details: 15 business workshops + 2 IT department workshops planned; structured selection and deployment phases. Associated tools and solutions: AS/400, AS400, CMMS, GIS, financial information systems. This reference documents OLING’s operational experience in financial information systems project advisory, GBCP, INFINOE, finance ERP and budget processes.
translations.shortDescription: Replace a legacy AS400 CMMS and manage the entire business-side IT project lifecycle securely, from assessment through deployment.

Roannaise de l’Eau – CMMS advisory and field service system modernisation
translations.description: Design a CMMS that interoperates with the business ecosystem of a public water utility. For Roannaise de l’Eau, OLING delivered an IT project advisory engagement covering finance information systems / GBCP / INFINOE in the water and sanitation sector. The documented objective was to modernise field service management and improve the reliability of data exchanges with technical, customer, HR, finance and GIS systems. OLING’s scope covered assessment; workshops; target architecture; functional requirements framework; technical specifications; tender process; selection; configuration; testing; user acceptance testing; change management. Available delivery details: Up to 20 functional and technical workshops; multi-system deployment roadmap. Associated tools and solutions: CMMS, ETL, GIS, finance/HR information systems. This case documents OLING’s operational experience in finance information system advisory, GBCP, INFINOE, finance ERP systems and budget processes.

Montpellier Méditerranée Airport – E-invoicing reform IT project advisory
translations.description: Bringing a heterogeneous airport IT system into compliance with e-invoicing and e-reporting requirements. For Montpellier Méditerranée Airport, OLING provided IT project advisory services for the e-invoicing reform in the airport and air transport sector. Define, select and implement the RFE roadmap. The documented services notably cover AMO AMM invoicing Phase 1: scoping, current-state assessment, use cases, target architecture and data flows; project management plan and RACI matrix; organisation of functional workshops; IT workshops; functional and technical workshop reports; mapping of current processes and identification of regulatory compliance gaps; mapping of target processes incorporating e-invoicing and its prerequisites. Associated tools and solutions: Chorus Pro, Advantage Finance, PDP / PA, PA/PDP, PPF. Associated frameworks and standards: RFE. This reference documents OLING’s operational experience in e-invoicing IT project advisory, e-invoicing reform, RFE, PDP and e-reporting.
translations.shortDescription: Bringing a heterogeneous airport IT system into compliance with e-invoicing and e-reporting requirements.

translations.designation: Design of an IT service catalogue for DTNSI's 2,000 staff
City of Goyave – IT project advisory for digitising correspondence management, document management, electronic archiving, e-signature workflows and VoIP
translations.description: Digitising a municipality’s administrative workflows and modernising its collaboration tools. For the City of Goyave, OLING provided IT project advisory services covering digitisation, document management, correspondence management and electronic archiving for a local authority / intermunicipal cooperation body. The documented objective was to replace largely paper-based processes with structured, traceable and secure digital services. OLING’s scope covers 3 work packages: correspondence management + meeting notices + e-signature workflows; document management + electronic archiving + digital displays; migration from analogue telephony to IP. Assessment, CCTP/DCE, selection, deployment, acceptance testing and change management. Available project details: Launch on 10/09/2025; 3 work packages; business and technical workshops, with a roadmap through to VSR. Associated tools and solutions: correspondence management, document management, electronic archiving, e-signature workflows, VoIP. This reference documents OLING’s operational experience in document management, correspondence management, electronic archiving, digitisation and electronic signature workflows.
translations.shortDescription: Digitising a municipality’s administrative workflows and modernising its collaboration tools.
